title: What The Koto Knows — EN/JA/ZH (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 98bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal koto English Japanese Chinese language learning trilingual world instruments
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The koto has thirteen strings
And plays exactly what it needs to — not more
The Japanese principle of the instrument
Is the same as the Japanese principle of everything else

[Verse 2 — 日本語]
琴を打つのではない — 触れるのだ [You don't strike the koto — you touch it]
打つことと触れることの違い [The difference between striking and touching]
は音を作ることと [Is the difference between making a sound]
音が起こるよう頼むことの違いだ [And asking a sound to happen]
琴は頼む [The koto asks]
音が来る [The sound arrives]

[Chorus — English]
What the koto knows
Cannot be rushed into
The string vibrates exactly once for each intention
What the koto knows — is the space between the mention

[Bridge — 中文]
查斯听到了一次琴音在一部关于日本的纪录片里 [Chas heard koto music once in a documentary about Japan]
他转向Wilma说 — 那就是板球 [He turned to Wilma and said — that's cricket]
那就是板球的声音 [That is the sound of cricket]
在运动之前的准备 [The preparation before the movement]
包含即将发生的一切的静止 [The stillness that contains everything that's about to happen]

[Verse 3 — English]
The koto and the mbira have never met formally
But they would understand each other immediately

[Outro — EN/JA/ZH]
What the koto knows
琴が知ること [What the koto knows]
古筝所知道的 [What the koto knows]
That's my boy
